ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New business, Closed won and later stages need Amount, Close date and Engagement type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_business", CASE(StageName, "Lead", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Brief and scope", 3, "Proposal sent (New business)", 4, "Pitch or review", 5, "Negotiation (New business)", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 7, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(CloseDate), ISBLANK(TEXT(Engagement_type__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Close date and Engagement type before moving to Closed won.
